idea-plugin.name: Phantom Strings
idea-plugin.description: Text conversions on each selection, or on the identifier at the caret: switch case (camelCase, snake_case, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, kebab-case, PascalCase in turn) or convert to one of them, dot.case, words, upper and lower case; escape and unescape Java/Kotlin strings and HTML/XML, URL and Base64 encode and decode; sort, reverse, shuffle, deduplicate, trim lines and remove blank ones. Alt+M opens them in a popup with speed search; they are also under Edit and the editor's context menu. Works with several carets. Replaces the StringManipulation plugin.

action.description: Show the text conversions in a popup
